description:
Search Panda Video help center articles to answer user questions.
Searches through ALL 136 pre-indexed articles from the official help center (https://help.pandavideo.com/pt-br/).
Use this tool whenever the user has a QUESTION about how Panda Video works, pricing, features, integrations, configuration, etc.
DO NOT use this for API execution commands — only for knowledge/support questions.
IMPORTANT: Base your answer EXCLUSIVELY on the article content returned. Do NOT infer, assume, or use external knowledge.

query.description: The user's question or search keywords about Panda Video
